configProperty.name: net.sf.jasperreports.compiler.max.groovy.method.size
configProperty.description: Property that determines the maximum size of a generated groovy method.

configProperty.name: net.sf.jasperreports.report.groovy.method.whitelist.{arbitrary_name}
configProperty.description:
Defines a list of Groovy methods that are allowed in report expressions when the report class filter is enabled via net.sf.jasperreports.report.class.filter.enabled.
The list applies to Groovy extension methods (such as the ones in org.codehaus.groovy.runtime.DefaultGroovyMethods or in other extension modules) and to the groovy.lang.GroovyObject meta methods (such as invokeMethod), which are implemented in classes other than the class of the object they are called on and are therefore not covered by the report class whitelist. Plain methods of whitelisted classes are not affected.
The property value should be a comma separated list of methods in the form implementingClassName.methodName, e.g. org.codehaus.groovy.runtime.StringGroovyMethods.capitalize. Wildcards are supported in the same way as for net.sf.jasperreports.report.class.whitelist.{arbitrary_name}, e.g. com.example.MyExtension.* allows all methods of the com.example.MyExtension extension class.
